validation_pipeline: validate form id and schema version
scan all free-text fields for direct identifiers and prohibited special-category content
reject or redact unsafe free text according to deterministic rules
generate random response_id with no identity lookup table
write only to research analytical storage
return generic receipt without echoing response content

storage.backup_policy: provider-specific, must obey same retention/deletion policy

retention.raw_pseudonymous_technical_layer: maximum 90 days unless a documented legal/audit requirement requires otherwise
retention.clean_analytical_dataset: retain only for documented research/audit purpose and then anonymize/delete under operator schedule
retention.server_logs: minimum operational period; must not be copied into analytical dataset

nf06_export.hash: SHA-256 over exact canonical UTF-8 export bytes
nf06_export.raw_export_rule: Freeze immutable exact export before analytical transformations; never commit respondent data to public repository.

minimum_requirements: all three regions have documented recruitment/coverage metadata
valid response denominator reported for every percentage
adult and employer datasets remain separate
no direct identifiers in analytical exports
no synthetic rows in PROD RUN
fail_closed_conditions: missing region for an analytical row
